fixed_scope_screening.qualification: Initial utility screen only. Of 10,802 distinct document contents, 10,702 were checked: 5,539 passed for detailed curation, 1,666 were held, and 3,497 had no target recipe; 100 remain access-blocked and unreviewed. Folder file totals include duplicate source copies and exclude three metadata files per folder. Pass does not establish an audited recipe–sample pair or training readiness.

recent_milestones.text: Phosphinate-ligated CdSe main/SI extraction is frozen after all 36 pages and relevant figures/captions were visually reviewed. Ten protocols, sixteen sample contexts and twelve observations keep QD, anisotropic, rod/tetrapod and CdS-rod condition families distinct. Independent audit is underway; no website contribution is published yet.

Pass-screen definition clarified: the 5,587 folder files represent 5,539 distinct contents (48 duplicate copies), and pass means useful synthesis/preparation plus reported structural, phase or morphology evidence—not a verified recipe–structure pair. Two short-paper extraction/audit/recheck cycles pass; matched phosphinate-CdSe main/SI extraction continues. Full-batch finish date remains provisional pending identity grouping and an end-to-end page cycle.

Wu et al. 2008 Cu2S main-article extraction is frozen after complete five-page visual review; independent audit is queued separately after Tirosh 2006. It preserves the growth/wash recipe, exchange/device-stock branch, glass/plastic device workflows, structural/optical outcomes and photovoltaic results. No matching SI candidate was found in the checked screening record, so SI remains unverified. The phosphinate-CdSe main/SI extraction continues.

Tirosh et al. 2006 cobalt ferrite extraction is frozen and hash-validated; its separate source audit has started. The main article coverage includes all six pages, Figures 1–7 and Table 1; SI is not located/verified. Wu et al. 2008 Cu2S and phosphinate-ligated CdSe extraction remain in progress. No new paper from this resumed batch has passed audit or been integrated into the website.

The fixed-folder screen reached 10,702/10,802 distinct document contents (99.074%). Decisions: 5,539 distinct pass contents, 1,666 held, 3,497 no-target and 100 blocked/unreviewed. User-directed deep curation resumed on three source candidates in parallel: Tirosh 2006 cobalt ferrite, Wu 2008 Cu2S, and phosphinate-ligated CdSe. Extraction is in progress; independent audits and website integration are pending. Later arrivals remain separate.

User-directed document-first screening activated: each main article and SI can proceed without prior pairing.13,831fixed copies mapped to12,136distinct content tasks;1,695duplicate copies retained. Existing source reading is reused, not reset. Daily schedule preserved and successive batches requested. No scientific records or screening completions added by this queue change.

Parallel Methods-first screening added 76 provisional scope checks (69 with usable preparation information; 7 deferred or held), plus reuse of one already-closed news scope. 97 provisional scopes now have tracked source-screen receipts, including aliases. Separate bounded checks passed for both mixed batches and the prior second atomic shortlist; selected phase candidates were spot-checked. No new scientific records or exact training pairs were published.

Daily review schedule preserved. First eight shortlisted articles passed a separate bounded synthesis/structure screening audit. A second eight-study batch identified two studies with printed product-coordinate candidates; independent audit and training admission remain pending.

Workflow simplified at user request: Methods/relevant SI first, structure evidence second. Unreadable files are deferred without blocking readable candidates. Full per-paper audits remain required for published data; no new training pairs claimed.

Corrected automated screen audited: 9,532 provisional groups, 13,831 copies and three nested identity holds. Nominations: 52 atomic-evidence, 655 phase-link and 433 morphology-link groups. All 238 manual format/text cases are retained for further screening. No scientific records or training pairs were added.

Chen source extraction passed its independent audit; Saini complete main/SI extraction is preserved for later audit. No new scientific records published.

workflow.summary: High-evidence documents are extracted and audited in parallel; source-reviewed records then feed reusable material/method reader pages and separate training exports.
workflow.screening_scope: The fixed screening collection contains 10,802 distinct document contents in 10,967 source files. Main articles and SI are separate documents; exact duplicate contents are counted once in distinct-content rates. The initial screen is 99.074% complete, with 100 access-blocked items still unreviewed. New arrivals remain queued separately.
steps: Screen every fixed-cutoff document independently; preserve source copies, format holds and prior coverage. Missing companions do not block screening.
Rank measured/refined atomic-structure candidates with usable recipes first; keep phase, size and morphology-linked recipes as a separate useful tier.
Verify recipe–sample–structure evidence within each retained source, and verify source relationships when joining information from different documents.
Retain all screened candidates and gaps; external reference cells, simulations and molecular-precursor coordinates do not become measured product pairs.
Build and publish academic material readers only after the selected paper’s source, data, figure and independent audit gates pass.
workflow.capacity: All three selected papers now have frozen structured extraction packages. Tirosh CoFe2O4 and Wu Cu2S passed independent source audits plus targeted correction rechecks; phosphinate-CdSe is in separate independent audit. Reader-page integration of these contributions has not yet completed, so website throughput is not measured.

estimate.summary: Provisional estimate for this three-source batch: 2–4 working days to close the CdSe independent audit and integrate all three audited source contributions into the material/method readers with validation. Extraction and audit are currently ahead of reader integration. The full pass-set finish date remains ungrounded until paper/source identities are reconciled and several end-to-end reader cycles are measured.
estimate.current_batch: Current batch: Tirosh et al. (2006) CoFe2O4 and Wu et al. (2008) Cu2S have passed full audits and targeted correction rechecks; phosphinate-ligated CdSe main + matched 24-page SI extraction is frozen and awaiting independent audit. None of the three new source contributions is site-published or training-ready.
notes: The pass folder contains 5,587 source-file copies but only 5,539 distinct source contents; 48 copies are duplicates. Main articles and SI are separate screen units, so this is not a verified unique-paper count.

The initial pass screen looks for potentially useful synthesis/preparation evidence and reported structure, phase or morphology evidence. Exact recipe-to-specimen mapping, complete parameter extraction, independent audit and training admission are later gates.

Observed pilot pace: two small five-to-six-page papers reached audited, correction-rechecked extractions concurrently. This selected pair is too small to represent long papers, scanned SI, variant-rich work or reader integration.

Illustrative capacity arithmetic only: at 30–60 minutes per verified source group, three concurrent lanes and eight productive hours per lane per day, 4,971 provisional groups would take about 103–207 working days before material-page integration. These assumptions are unvalidated and exclude additional site redesign/source-resolution time; this is not a completion forecast.
Material/method pages group separately attributed source contributions; every experimentally distinct recipe/sample variant remains a separate underlying dataset record.
Original PDFs and SI remain local. No paid API or new cloud processing run has been started.
